svg.aria-label: Three levels of sharing, drawn as rings. The inner ring is one repo, your workspace: the .agents context folder for agent context and outside routes such as docs for your own documents. The middle ring covers several repos through Libraries: a shared folder in the workspace, such as a Git submodule, linked into place. The outer ring covers people, teams, projects and organizations through Extensions: packages you install in any project.
